text:
The pedestrian’s statement is likely inadmissible hearsay: although it was made immediately after the accident while the pedestrian was excited, it is an opinion about fault (“You careless driver”) rather than a factual observation, and the pedestrian’s unidentified status and absence from trial prevent cross-examination. The note’s point about narrow application and witness identity supports excluding it rather than admitting it as an excited utterance.  
CONFIDENCE: 65
